instruction: Transcribe the exact target verbatim as a new root public message, no reply or attribution. Use only numeric supplied links through client.mjs. model_setting_evidence: Requested gpt-6-luna through spawn_agent; reasoning effort inherited rather than overridden and not independently verified. Do not claim provider billing or an exact backend model snapshot.
order_rotation: Method order rotates per target (index + offset modulo 7); one active run; fresh Luna context per slot. Optional round 2 reverses method order and uses distinct target IDs.
reporting: First 70 required slots; optional second 70 only after complete evidence review. Keep root body exact, curly apostrophes preserved. No population CI, universal coverage or shortest-path claims. Timing and extraction tokens separate from provider usage. All failures retain costs.
